items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: And Hoppy {PHONETIC} -- and that was Hoppy {PHONETIC} -- that was the guy's name that was with the INK Spots.

ctx.x: Which was taken from the Rhythm Club up here in Harlem. And I mean it was named after that you know. And he had a kind of act on there. That's when the first time the INK Spots got to be known.

Fats had a little disagreement I think with the management of WOLN, so they hired the Ink Spots to take that place. And they had a guy in there called Hoppy {PHONETIC} in that show. And Hoppy {PHONETIC} -- and that was Hoppy {PHONETIC} -- that was the guy's name that was with the INK Spots. That's how he got the name Hoppy {PHONETIC}.
It was because -- you know -- had that character and kept calling him Hoppy {PHONETIC} when they got to be the Ink Spots. Do you understand?
